subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom Phrase.

To make one's mouth water
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Feel hungry'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given phrase **"To make one's mouth water"** is an idiom which means to cause one to desire or anticipate something pleasant. (मुंह में पानी आना). 
 
• The correct phrase **"Feel hungry"** captures the essence of this idiom, as it refers to a feeling of wanting to eat something, which is similar in meaning to the given idiom.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **Feel hungry'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'To make faces' **means to grimace in an exaggerated way, often to express dislike or mockery. (मुंह बनान).
 
• **'To tremble with fear'** means to shake involuntarily, typically as a result of anxiety, excitement, or frailty.(भय से कापना).
 
• **'To feel no pain'** is an expression used to describe a state where one does not feel physical discomfort, often due to the influence of alcohol or drugs.(दर्द महसूस ना करना).
